description: Reverse call graph: the symbols that call or reference qualified_name (from search_symbols), each with its file and lines, like `git grep -w <name>` restricted to call sites. HEAD only; macro expansion and function pointers are not followed. limit caps the list. Read a caller with git_show_file at its line.

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

name: get_callers
